images.description: Waiting for your OK: "Approve all (6)" (3 tasks, 2 heard dates, yesterday's summary draft), the "Hold to choose what to approve" hint and Choose…
Holding Approve all opens the checklist: every task, event and the summary draft, all ticked
The summary unticked: "Approve selected (5)"; the summary keeps waiting for its own OK
After Approve selected: tasks and events approved, the summary still waits; the toast offers Undo
One tap on Approve all: no question, everything approved; the toast offers Undo (it takes back exactly that batch)
Day review, From this day: "Approve all from this day (5)", including that day's summary draft
An approved day review: "Edit text" under the title
Edit text: the title and each section's heading and text, Save disabled until something changes
Edited: the title and the first section; the sheet guards a stray close with Discard Changes?
Saved: the new title and text, "Edited by you", and Undo in the toast
